about: The hosts an item, a licence link or a node may point to. The build fails on any other host, so a new host is a deliberate, reviewed change (security pre-review, 18 November 2026). The site itself fetches nothing from any of them. github.com added 18 November 2026 for the hand pages' links to this repository (AppSec post-review finding 1).

never_read_by_machine.websummit.com: Web Summit's terms 48.2 and 52.1 forbid automated reading (recorded by the team on 11 November 2026). Linked only; never fetched, checked or crawled by an agent or a script.
